newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan continued to rebound on Monday to close up at 8.2956 from last Friday's 8.2960 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai, traders said.
The weighted average price on Friday was 8.2956.

The yuan opened higher at an intraday low of 8.2959 and consolidated between 8.2955 and 8.2958 for most of the session, hitting an intraday high of 8.2928 late in the session. Most trading was done at about 8.2956, traders said.
Traders said the yuan maintained its upward trend after closing at a two-month low last Tuesday but it was still capped at about 8.2950.
One dealer said the yuan was strongly supported above 8.2959 on expectations the upward movement would continue.
But its rise was capped by selling at about 8.2950, he added.
Traders said they expected the yuan to consolidate between 8.2950 and 8.2960 on Tuesday.
The yuan ended down at 6.7661 from 6.7101 against 100 Japanese yen and down slightly at 1.0713 from 1.0711 against the Hong Kong dollar.
